PagerBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 6742003333 - GPU hotpool saturation detected. queue_metric: gpu_request_queue > 1200 for 3m. paging SRE oncall. severity: P1. https://internal.ops/incidents/6742003333
Zoe (SRE oncall): I'm on it. seeing large enqueue on inference-queue-prod, latency spiking > 4s on hosts serving downstream. any deploys recently?
Matt (Infra): No recent LT (launch template) deploys in the last 2h. autoscaler logs show repeated failed create for nodegroup "gpu-hotpool-2" with 403 from EC2: AttachRoleWithIam failed.
Raj (ML Serving): Customers hitting model timeouts, some requests getting 502s. traffic shift around 09:05 UTC to a new route bumped token cost. Impacting endpoints: /v1/generate-large and /v1/chat-stream.
Ella (CS): I'm seeing tickets from 3 enterprise customers saying requests are timing out and UX shows "waiting...". I'll start customer comms.
Zoe (SRE oncall): Paste of autoscaler error snippet: ```ERROR autoscaler: nodegroup create failed: CreateFleet failed: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform this operation. status code: 403, request id: 8a1f...```
Matt (Infra): Looks like the instance profile/attach-role call is failing. IAM AssumeRole passrole condition maybe missing for the autoscaler service account. I'll check instance profile and LT perms.
Li (Eng Ops): Confirming a rollout of LT v3 happened yesterday by DeployBot, but it was for CPU pools only. DeployBot, did anything touch gpu-hotpool launch template?
DeployBot: Deployment record: 6741900000 - LT update cpu-pool-v3. No changes to gpu-hotpool LT. No manual edits recorded.
Raj (ML Serving): Meanwhile queue is growing, current queued tokens ~1.4M. We should put a temporary throttling policy on non-critical routes to protect core customers. Can we hotfix a route-level rate limit?
Zoe (SRE oncall): Agreed. Matt, can you manually add nodes while we sort IAM? We need capacity ASAP.
Matt (Infra): Manual instance launch fails too, same 403 on role attach. Looks like the nodegroup instance profile role lost the passrole permission. Investigating policy drift.
Ella (CS): ETA for customer comms? I'll post a short note in #customer-impact and flag enterprise CSMs.
Zoe (SRE oncall): Triage plan: 1) Identify cause (IAM change?) 2) Fallback mitigate - reroute low-priority traffic to dedicated fallback (if capacity) or enable degraded model fallback. 3) Manual scale with pre-baked AMI if we can bypass role attach. 4) Postmortem owner.
Matt (Infra): Found recent policy change: org-admins removed sts:AssumeRole for service-autoscaler role in the last hour (audit: user:ops-iam-batch). Rolling backing. Attempting to re-add passrole/principal:ec2.amazonaws.com for that role.
Raj (ML Serving): Can we start diverting traffic to smaller model variants? Use model-compact-1 for non-enterprise routes and rate-limit token size to 512 for normals. That buys time.
Li (Eng Ops): I can push quick routing change in the router: add header-based rule to route requests with header x-customer-tier:standard -> model-compact-1. Pushing now.
DeployBot: Router change applied: rtr-112 patched. Traffic for standard tier now routed to model-compact-1. 200 upstreams switched.
Zoe (SRE oncall): Monitor queue after route change.
Raj (ML Serving): Queue dropped to ~420k in 4m. Latency for critical routes still high but stable. Excellent, thanks Li.
Matt (Infra): IAM rollback applied. Re-triggering autoscaler create for gpu-hotpool-2. Command: ```kubectl -n kube-system exec -it autoscaler -- /bin/sh -c "./scale up nodegroup gpu-hotpool-2"```
Matt (Infra): Autoscaler returned success: create initiated. EC2 instances provisioning.
DeployBot: New instances launching: i-0a1b2c3d (pending), i-0e4f5g6h (pending).
Zoe (SRE oncall): Watch for taint errors on join. Common issue: kubelet register fails if launch template doesn't include kubelet bootstrap tokens or wrong taint key.
Matt (Infra): Nodes joined but taints applied incorrectly: kube-system set taint "gpu:NoSchedule" unexpectedly due to bootstrap script mismatch. Removing taint on new nodes: ```kubectl taint nodes i-0a1b2c3d gpu:NoSchedule-```
Raj (ML Serving): Pods scheduling on new nodes, beginning to warm KV caches. Traffic flowing. Queue down to ~80k. Token-level cost normalized.
Ella (CS): Notifying affected customers: initial message sent. Will follow up with SLA impact calc.
Zoe (SRE oncall): Marking incident as mitigated. Remaining actions: 1) Confirm autoscaler IAM role perms persist (Matt) 2) Validate LT bootstrap scripts across gpu pools (Raj/Matt) 3) Postmortem draft (Zoe) 4) Customer impact report (Ella). Assigning owners in thread.
Matt (Infra): I'll create an org-iam ticket to re-add the least-privilege passrole for autoscaler and add guardrails so a PR is required to change. Ticket: ORG-IAM-4219.
Raj (ML Serving): I'll open a playbook PR to ensure launch template bootstrap includes correct taint handling and kubelet args. Also add a canary group for LT changes. PR: infra/lt-fixes#987
Ella (CS): I've logged 3 enterprise incidents and started SLA exposure calc. Will share in #customer-impact in 30m.
Li (Eng Ops): Reverting router rule after autoscaler stabilized? Keep for 15 more minutes to be safe.
Zoe (SRE oncall): Good work team. Post-incident, we'll run an eval to see if Optimize recommendations should have flagged the LT drift and IAM risk. Adding follow-up: review alerts for IAM permission removals. :thumbsup:
PagerBot: Incident 6742003333 status -> mitigated. Duration: 00:48:45. Pager timeline and runbook links: https://internal.ops/incidents/6742003333/runbook
Zoe (SRE oncall): I'll start the postmortem doc and ping owners for writeups. Closing thread for live mitigation."
